tools.name: innovint_list_wineries
tools.description: List the connected winery with id, name and the user's permissions. Hosted connections and scoped stdio return only the selected winery; unscoped stdio lists all accessible wineries. GET /api/v1/wineries or /api/v1/wineries/{wineryId}.

tools.name: innovint_get_winery
tools.description: One winery by id: name, internal id and the token user's permissions there. GET /api/v1/wineries/{wineryId}.

tools.name: innovint_list_lots
tools.description: List the winery's lots (wine, juice, fruit or case-goods batches) with code, name, stage, color, type, tax class, volume, weight, bottles on hand and tags. Filter by search term, code, id, bond, archived state or last update. GET /api/v1/wineries/{wineryId}/lots.

tools.name: innovint_get_lot
tools.description: One lot by id with its stage, volume, weight, bottles on hand, tags and links to related data. GET /api/v1/wineries/{wineryId}/lots/{id}.

tools.name: innovint_get_lot_composition
tools.description: The lot's makeup composition (what it is made of), now or right after a given action. GET /api/v1/wineries/{wineryId}/lots/{lotId}/makeupComposition.

tools.name: innovint_get_lot_components_summary
tools.description: A summary of the lot's components. GET /api/v1/wineries/{wineryId}/lots/{lotId}/componentsSummary.

tools.name: innovint_list_lot_analyses
tools.description: Lab and in-house analysis results recorded on a lot (pH, TA, free SO2, Brix, VA, ...). Filter by analysis type slug, vessel or date range. GET /api/v1/wineries/{wineryId}/lots/{lotId}/analyses.

tools.name: innovint_list_lot_additives
tools.description: Additives that have been added to a lot. GET /api/v1/wineries/{wineryId}/lots/{lotId}/additives.

tools.name: innovint_list_lot_costs
tools.description: Cost data per lot as of a date. Filter by lot code or id. GET /api/v1/wineries/{wineryId}/lotCosts.

tools.name: innovint_list_vessels
tools.description: List tanks, barrels and other vessels with their codes and current contents. Filter by search term, code, id, lot or archived state. GET /api/v1/wineries/{wineryId}/vessels.

tools.name: innovint_list_vessels_at_point_in_time
tools.description: Preview (vendor contract may change): What every vessel held at a past date-time (history of cellar contents). GET /api/v1/wineries/{wineryId}/vesselsAtPointInTime.

tools.name: innovint_list_actions
tools.description: The winery's work history across all action types (additions, analyses, transfers, racking, blending, bottling, fruit receiving, ...), filterable by type, state, reference number and dates. Each record has the action type, effective date and the lots and vessels involved; use the typed list tools fo

tools.name: innovint_list_analysis_actions
tools.description: Analysis actions: the lab and in-house results entered in the winery, with the analyses (type, value, unit) and the lots and vessels they were taken on. GET /api/v1/wineries/{wineryId}/actions/analysisActions.

tools.name: innovint_list_addition_actions
tools.description: Addition actions: what additives were added to which lots and vessels, and when. GET /api/v1/wineries/{wineryId}/additionActions.

tools.name: innovint_list_transfer_actions
tools.description: Transfer actions: racking, filtering, topping off, barrel-down and other transfers between vessels. GET /api/v1/wineries/{wineryId}/transferActions.

tools.name: innovint_list_adjustment_actions
tools.description: Adjustment actions: volume or weight changes, water adds and makeup changes. GET /api/v1/wineries/{wineryId}/actions/adjustmentActions.

tools.name: innovint_list_receive_fruit_actions
tools.description: Fruit receiving actions (harvest intake) with the fruit received and the lots created. GET /api/v1/wineries/{wineryId}/actions/receiveFruitActions.

tools.name: innovint_list_analysis_types
tools.description: The analysis types InnoVint knows (pH, TA, free SO2, Brix, ...), with the slug that innovint_create_analysis_action and the analysis filters need. GET /api/v1/analysisTypes.

tools.name: innovint_list_additives
tools.description: The winery's additive products and their batches. GET /api/v1/wineries/{wineryId}/additives.

tools.name: innovint_list_vineyards
tools.description: The winery's vineyards (grower sources). GET /api/v1/wineries/{wineryId}/vineyards.

tools.name: innovint_list_blocks
tools.description: Vineyard blocks of the winery's vineyards. Filter by vineyard. GET /api/v1/wineries/{wineryId}/blocks.

tools.name: innovint_list_growers
tools.description: The growers the winery buys fruit from. GET /api/v1/wineries/{wineryId}/growers.

tools.name: innovint_list_grower_receipts
tools.description: Fruit receipts from growers for one vintage (year). GET /api/v1/wineries/{wineryId}/growerReceipts/{vintage}.

tools.name: innovint_list_vendors
tools.description: The winery's vendors (suppliers of additives, dry goods, services). GET /api/v1/wineries/{wineryId}/vendors.

tools.name: innovint_list_bonds
tools.description: The winery's bonded premises (TTB bonds), whose ids lots belong to. GET /api/v1/wineries/{wineryId}/bonds.

tools.name: innovint_create_analysis_action
tools.description: WRITE: records analysis results (e.g. pH 3.45, free SO2 28 mg/L) as a new analysis action in the winery's InnoVint records, effective at the given time. Each result needs an analysis type slug (innovint_list_analysis_types), a value and a unit, and a lot (add a vessel for a vessel-level result; with

tools.name: innovint_create_vendor
tools.description: WRITE: adds a new vendor (supplier) by name to the winery's InnoVint records. Check innovint_list_vendors first to avoid a duplicate. POST /api/v1/wineries/{wineryId}/vendors.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: innovint_create_vendor · Private data: innovint_get_winery, innovint_list_actions, innovint_create_analysis_action, innovint_create_vendor · Public sink: innovint_create_analysis_action, innovint_create_vendor · Destructive: innovint_create_analysis_action.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: innovint_create_vendor · Private data: innovint_get_winery, innovint_list_actions, innovint_create_analysis_action, innovint_create_vendor · Public sink: innovint_create_analysis_action, innovint_create_vendor · Destructive: innovint_create_analysis_action

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
